primary_estimand: repeat-1 out-of-fold delta_AUROC = AUROC(rich comparator + stripped Open-Jev) - AUROC(rich comparator)

primary_uncertainty.method: patient-cluster bootstrap of paired repeat-1 out-of-fold predictions without model refitting
primary_uncertainty.sampling_rule: sample source patients with replacement; include all ICU rows from sampled patients with patient multiplicity in both model prediction vectors
primary_uncertainty.interpretation: conditional on the frozen fitted cross-validated prediction functions and repeat-1 partition; quantifies patient-sampling variability of observed discrimination, not full training-sample refit variance

split_stability.report: delta_AUROC point estimate for each repeat plus range across repeats
split_stability.purpose: show sensitivity to refitting under alternative frozen patient-grouped fold assignments

multiplicity: No confirmatory p-values or binary significance decisions. Ventilation, RRT, and MetaVision ICU death are three prespecified co-primary estimands reported separately. No Holm testing is applied.
claim_rule: Do not label an outcome positive/negative by a p-value or CI crossing zero. Report effect estimate, primary conditional interval, and split-stability estimates; interpret magnitude and uncertainty.
secondary_uncertainty: Secondary metrics and sensitivity analyses use compatible patient-cluster fixed-prediction bootstrap intervals where feasible; they do not create additional confirmatory claims.

runtime_reaudit.trigger: Independent reproduction reported the same script-111 HGB workload at roughly 12 seconds per full replicate rather than 5470 seconds.
runtime_reaudit.rule: Do not register or execute real-label performance until this synthetic-only audit is terminal and the final uncertainty procedure is re-frozen.
